name: llegomark/wp-blog-kit
description: Tala Blog block theme and the Tala SEO, Tala Ads and Tala Guard plugins, with the WordPress development tools used to check them.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check PHP against the WordPress Coding Standards (phpcs.xml.dist).
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply automatic WordPress Coding Standards fixes.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Static analysis with PHPStan and the WordPress extension (phpstan.neon.dist).
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check: Run WordPress Plugin Check on tala-seo, tala-ads and tala-guard against the local site.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every check: coding standards, static analysis and Plugin Check.
scripts-descriptions.test:install: Download WordPress for the tests (.cache/wordpress) and create the empty test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:multisite: The tests that need a network (@group ms-required), on a multisite test install.
scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit integration tests on WordPress's test framework (phpunit.xml.dist), then the multisite ones.
